attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No Yang-Mills estimate yet supplies the finite-block reflected Wilson boundary OPE coefficients H,K with a valid uniform remainder for actual hairpin/cusp collars.
steps: Normalize a finite Wilson collar quotient so its leading collapsed block is J=11^* and its diagonal entries are one.
Decompose C^n=C e direct sum e^perp with e=n^{-1/2}1 and P=I-ee^*.
Write the block Schur complement of M_eta relative to the large eigenvalue n+eta e^*He+O(eta^2).
The projected Schur complement is eta PHP+eta^2(PKP-n^{-1}PHee^*HP)+o(eta^2), equivalently eta PHP+eta^2(PKP-n^{-2}PH11^*HP)+o(eta^2).
Therefore a negative value of PHP on 1^perp gives a first-order determinant falsifier; if PHP has a null vector, the corrected second-order form decides the next obstruction.
Check diagonal congruence D_eta: H gains a1^*+1a^*, K gains the expected cross terms. On x in ker(PHP), the added |x^*a|^2 and cross terms cancel exactly against the changed Schur correction.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The finite-matrix tangent lemma is formal. The missing analytic input is computing or bounding H,K for the locked gauge-invariant Wilson algebra and proving the quotient M_eta really represents the same continuum Schwinger functions.

assumptions: M_eta is Hermitian and entrywise admits a two-term boundary OPE expansion M_eta=11^*+eta H+eta^2 K+o(eta^2) for eta downarrow 0.
e=n^{-1/2}1 and P=I-ee^*; H and K are the locked mixed boundary OPE coefficients after additive positive contacts have been eliminated by diagonal trace continuity.
The expansion remainder is uniform on the chosen finite Wilson block, so Schur-complement signs are valid for sufficiently small eta.
The Schur denominator n+eta e^*He+O(eta^2) stays positive, which follows from the rank-one leading block 11^*.
definitions: source object: finite locked reflected Wilson collar quotient blocks M_eta=widehat N_eta oslash widehat B_eta from regulated reflection-positive Schwinger forms, after diagonal normalization M_{ii}=1 and common boundary-footprint collapse.
target object: OS-positive continuum Schwinger functions on the unchanged gauge-invariant Wilson algebra, equivalently all finite same-theory reflected quadratic matrices are positive semidefinite.

controlled interface: regulated reflection-positive Schwinger forms -> OS-positive continuum Schwinger functions by closed-cone passage plus finite Schur-preimage positivity of Wilson boundary quotients.

same-theory condition: diagonal/rank-one one-body Wilson factors may be absorbed as congruences, but no mixed boundary counterterm, non-diagonal Schur factor, or observable-algebra change may be used to repair positivity.

equations.label: finite Schur-preimage OS matrix
equations.valid_when: Additive contacts have vanished, every boundary factor entry in widehat B_eta is nonzero, and this is the same Wilson test family before and after collar collapse.

equations.label: rank-one boundary expansion
equations.valid_when: The reflected Wilson boundary OPE is valid entrywise with a uniform finite-block remainder.

equations.label: first tangent gate
equations.valid_when: M_eta is positive for all sufficiently small eta>0; a negative vector in 1^perp is an immediate falsifier.

equations.label: second tangent gate
equations.valid_when: The first gate is semidefinite and x lies in its null space; this is the Schur complement against the large rank-one OS direction.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Find a locked finite Wilson block and x in 1^perp with x^*PHPx<0, or x in ker(PHP) with x^*Omega_2x<0; either is a finite same-theory falsifier of the OS bridge.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This lemma converts the Wilson boundary same-theory problem into computable OPE data H,K and removes false obstructions caused only by one-body Wilson normalizations.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Rank-one-normalized Wilson collar quotients have a valid second-order OS obstruction: if M_eta=11^*+eta H+eta^2 K+o(eta^2) is required to be positive for eta>0, then PHP>=0 on 1^perp, and on L=ker(PHP) the Schur-corrected form Omega_2=PKP-n^{-2}PH11^*HP must be nonnegative. This test is invariant under harmless one-body diagonal Wilson renormalizations.

assumptions: D_eta is invertible for small eta.
The same vector space of Wilson observables is used; no non-diagonal boundary mixing is introduced.
M_eta has the two-term expansion of L1.
definitions: D_eta represents admissible one-body Wilson renormalization already present in the locked theory.
The invariant data are the projected first form PHP and the Schur-corrected null-space second form Omega_2.
Congruence by D_eta preserves finite OS positivity and hence must not create a genuine obstruction.
Mixed boundary OPE terms are exactly those not removable by this diagonal congruence.

equations.label: congruence variation
equations.valid_when: D_eta=I+eta diag(a)+eta^2 diag(b)+O(eta^3) and terms are collected through order eta^2.

equations.label: null-space cancellation
equations.valid_when: x is orthogonal to 1 and PHPx=0; the Schur correction cancels the a-dependent cross terms.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If a claimed obstruction disappears only by a non-diagonal D_eta or by changing Wilson-loop renormalization at the reflection plane, it is a same-theory failure, not a harmless gauge.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: It proves the proposed falsifier detects mixed boundary defects rather than arbitrary normalization conventions.
candidate_lemmas.statement: The second-order form Omega_2 is normalization-safe: under D_eta=I+eta diag(a)+eta^2 diag(b)+O(eta^3), the congruent block D_eta M_eta D_eta^* has the same PHP and the same quadratic values of Omega_2 on ker(PHP).

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot only if reflected Wilson OPE expansions are unavailable in any topology compatible with RG compactness, or if all available positivity repairs require changing the gauge-invariant algebra.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote if a dense Wilson core satisfies PHP>=0 and Omega_2>=0 with valid uniform remainders, plus the fixed-collar closed-cone transfer.
control_decision.reason: The branch is now producing sharp finite-matrix invariants rather than restating closed-cone topology; the next obstacle is a concrete Yang-Mills boundary OPE calculation.

dependency_updates.description: The closed-cone transfer remains valid for fixed collars; the nonformal Wilson collapse is now a finite Schur-preimage tangent-cone problem with invariant first and second gates.
Same-theory admissible renormalization is restricted to diagonal/rank-one congruence. Mixed boundary OPE corrections must satisfy the invariant tangent tests.
The topology must give entrywise convergence and uniform two-term reflected Wilson boundary OPE remainders for finite blocks, not merely distributional convergence away from the reflection plane.
Compute PHP and Omega_2 for common-footprint reflected Wilson hairpins or prove a structural positivity theorem for them.

falsifiers: falsifier: a locked Wilson block with some x in 1^perp and x^*PHPx<0, producing a negative OS determinant at order eta.
falsifier: PHP>=0 but a null vector x has x^*(PKP-n^{-2}PH11^*HP)x<0.
falsifier: a three-hairpin quotient determinant det(widehat N oslash widehat B)<0 even though all pairwise damping inequalities are valid.
falsifier: positivity can be restored only by a non-diagonal boundary counterterm or by changing the Wilson test algebra at the reflection plane.
falsifier: the RG cutoff-removal topology does not control the reflected Wilson OPE remainder strongly enough to make the tangent expansion valid.
branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 222 made the second-order Wilson obstruction normalization-invariant. The valid finite test is not PKP alone: the large rank-one OS direction subtracts n^{-2}PH11^*HP. This correction also cancels every one-body diagonal Wilson renormalization, so a remaining negative value is a genuine mixed boundary falsifier. The branch has therefore isolated a concrete analytic target: compute H and K for locked reflected Wilson hairpin blocks with uniform collar remainders.
branch_outputs.next_experiment: Pick three mirror-smooth Wilson hairpin observables with a common reflection-plane footprint, derive the boundary OPE coefficients H and K for M_eta=widehat N_eta oslash widehat B_eta, and test PHP and Omega_2 on 1^perp and ker(PHP).
